title: Odile and the Undertow
author: Astrid Eriksen
blurb: Freya Galloway, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
